source_audit.deepseek4_default_path: build_expert_mix receives cur_ffn, selected_experts, weights, then builds separate gate/up/down mul_mat_id graph nodes and sums expert outputs. It does not pass a retained GPU gate tensor into a later hot branch.
source_audit.existing_ds4_hot_dispatch: DS4_HOT_DISPATCH is the closest graph-level mechanism, but its layer_hot_state allocates K + P + 1 hot tensor rows per active layer and uses dummy rows to avoid mul_mat_id dedup issues. For sparse top48/top64 profiles this is the wrong payload class.
source_audit.existing_sparse_retained_probe: deepseek4_sparse_retained_graph_probe_write records graph facts and already hardcodes graph_gate_output_input_available=false for the current build_expert_mix inputs.
source_audit.one_stream_sparse_graph_probe: The one-stream probe in moe_stream.cu records CPU-backend helper transfers. Prior validation showed it returns through CPU memory and has no zero-transfer retained GPU output.
source_audit.json_loader_reuse: src/llama-deepseek4-hot.cpp already uses nlohmann/json and can serve as style reference for a compact sparse profile loader, but its allocation/remap shape must not be reused directly.

minimum_next_source_step.kind: default-off placement/proof skeleton before any logit-writing path
minimum_next_source_step.reason: The refreshed hard-bound is above 10 tok/s, but implementation risk is dataflow/payload, not arithmetic alone. A proof skeleton can validate compact top48 profile loading and per-layer pair selection without changing logits.
minimum_next_source_step.required_output: CSV/JSON with per layer selected pairs, compact payload bytes, whether selected_experts contains each pair, whether gate output is available as retained GPU tensor, estimated gate-output H2D or gate recompute path, and whether current graph would fall back to CPU-backend transfers.
must_not_do: Do not enable DS4_HOT_DISPATCH as the implementation path.
Do not allocate K+P+1 dummy rows per active layer.
Do not write logits or clear CPU fallback counts.
Do not run a strict cold SOTA benchmark from placement proof alone.

followup_after_skeleton.if_defaultoff_top1_passes: Add a compare-only MMVQ fused hot-pair kernel/probe that runs after authoritative CPU fallback and records op-level error and timing.
followup_after_skeleton.if_payload_or_gate_reuse_fails: Reject this route or fall back to a corrected CPU-backend bound with selected gate-output H2D/recompute explicitly measured.
followup_after_skeleton.before_write_skip: A write/skip mode requires fixed-text llama-results same_top1 == n_tokens under strict 16GB/no-swap cgroup before any France performance run.

decision.next_edit: Implement only the default-off compact sparse fused MMVQ placement/proof skeleton.
